item.tib: zhing bkod shes rab mchog gi rgyan ldan
item.coloph: zhing khams kun gyi bkod pa shes rab mchog gi rgyan ldan bum mdzes zhes bya ba/ g.yu mtshog sman ni zhes bya ba'i don du/ bla brang nang nas bzhengs pa de bkod pa'i yid dbang rab rgyas/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ming gis brtsams pa dge legs 'phel//
